SELECT uno,id,name,phone,email,status,profile_img,created_at,updated_at,enabled FROM users
AND uno LIKE '%'||#{name}||'%' OR id LIKE '%'||#{name}||'%' OR name LIKE '%'||#{name}||'%' OR phone LIKE '%'||#{name}||'%' OR email LIKE '%'||#{name}||'%'
ORDER BY uno ASC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 6 ROWS ONLY

SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/6.0) FROM users
AND name LIKE '%'||#{name}||'%'
